control.purpose: Ordinary readable buttons and input labels.

archival-code.purpose: Cipher text and literal archival notation only.

narrative.northStar: The sealed invitation and its parchment investigation desk
narrative.overview: The whole website inherits the user-approved bordeaux, gold, warm paper and original engraved artwork. Game interaction remains task-oriented and separate from the invitation.
keyCharacteristics: One material world across every route.
Live readable text and native touch/keyboard controls.
A truly horizontal six-position archive with mobile scrolling.

rules.name: One world, separate tasks
rules.body: Share materials and typography, not the invitation's whole-screen click gesture.

rules.name: Six horizontal positions
rules.body: Cards remain left-to-right, with pointer, touch, buttons and keyboard operating on the same order.

dos: Keep story, codes, evidence and saved-progress keys unchanged.
Contain intentional card, table and cipher scrolling.
Respect focus, reduced motion, touch targets and text zoom.
donts: Do not automatically solve or rearrange the archive.
Do not expose sealed material through navigation.
Do not impose theatrical transitions on ordinary game tasks.
